decisions.executionNote: Raise left arm along an elbow-up arc and turn toward the left tube; right arm remains at origin.
Continue left approach above the tube, rotating the open gripper to align with its axis while keeping the elbow raised.
Finish aligning the left gripper downward and descend toward the tube body; leave fingers open for visual alignment.
Center the tube between the left fingertips, lower the last centimeter, and close. Retention will be checked during lift.
Lift the first tube clear of the table with the left gripper closed; check that the tube follows.
The first tube remains between the fingers. Carry it toward the rack while rotating it upright in small continuous increments.
Continue upright rotation and approach the left portion of the rack, holding above the openings.
Finish vertical alignment of the held tube over the left large rack opening; approach gently before insertion.
Refine the tube position over the left slot and lower toward the rack, keeping it upright and retained.
Lower the first tube vertically to seating depth, without lateral movement. Keep the gripper closed until seating is inspected.
Open the left gripper to leave the first tube in its slot, then withdraw upward and back without touching the rack.
First tube stands released in the rack. Withdraw the left arm toward origin and begin the right arm's elbow-up approach to the next tube.
Continue returning the left arm and move the right gripper above the inner right tube, aligning its long axis.
Return the left arm near origin while bringing the right open fingers into a downward grasp alignment above the inner tube.
Center the inner right tube between the fingertips and descend to grasp height; leave the gripper open until alignment is checked.
Make a small final centering and axis correction, then close the right gripper around the second tube.
Lift the second tube clear while keeping the right gripper closed; verify retention before rotating toward the rack.
The second tube follows the gripper. Begin carrying it toward the right rack slot while rotating upright in small increments.
Continue rotating the retained second tube upright while approaching above the right side of the rack.
Finish upright alignment above the rightmost large slot, keeping the tube above insertion depth for a visual check.
Fine-center the second tube above the right slot and lower vertically toward the opening.
Seat the second tube with a straight controlled descent, keeping the gripper closed until the depth is checked.
The second tube appears to have contacted the slot rim. Lift clear and make a small rightward centering correction before retrying.
Retry a gentle vertical insertion at the corrected position; inspect whether the tube enters instead of sliding in the fingers.
Release the second tube over the corrected opening and withdraw slightly to inspect its seating without pushing the rack.
The second tube has dropped to a similar height as the first. Withdraw the right gripper clear and prepare to pick the remaining far-right tube.
Move rightward above the table toward the final tube, rotating the open gripper gradually into a downward approach.
Continue the high right-arm approach to the remaining tube, maintaining smooth elbow-up configuration and open fingers.
Align the right gripper downward above the last tube and approach its body, keeping the fingers open.
Refine the final tube's axis alignment from the wrist view and lower the open right fingers toward its body.
Center and align the final tube, descend to grasp height, then close the right gripper around its body.
Lift the final tube with the right gripper closed and verify it remains securely between the fingers.
The final tube is retained. Carry it inward at clearance height while beginning the upright rotation.
Continue inward transport and upright rotation of the final tube, staying above the two seated tubes.
Bring the final tube upright above the central empty slot while maintaining clearance over the seated tubes.
Fine-align the upright final tube over the empty central large opening, remaining above the rack.
Make a small centering correction and lower the final tube toward the central opening, retaining it upright.
Lower the final tube straight into the central slot, monitoring for rim contact before releasing.
Contact prevented the final descent. Lift clear and restore upright alignment before selecting a less obstructed approach to the center slot.
Pivot the retained tube to a more frontal approach while keeping it above the central opening, improving clearance from the right seated tube.
Lower the final tube along the revised frontal approach, watching for contact with neighboring tubes or the slot rim.
The revised approach is tracking freely. Continue a slow vertical descent to seat the final tube in the center slot.
Release the final tube into the center slot, then retreat backward and upward with care around the neighboring tubes.
All three tubes appear released in the rack. Withdraw the right arm safely and begin returning to origin with the gripper open.
Continue returning both arms toward their initial poses with open grippers; inspect the tubes as the rack becomes unobstructed.
